title: BDSS — Meeting Room Scheduling
subtitle: Book and manage the 3 meeting rooms and VIP room in real time — green means vacant, red means occupied.
featureRealtimeBody: Every room's calendar updates the moment a booking is made — no more walking over to check if a room is free.
featureRolesBody: Admins manage rooms and reports; front desk staff handle day-to-day bookings and check-ins.
featureBiometricBody: Check-in today is staff-confirmed, built on an interface ready for fingerprint or face verification hardware.
